status_note: experimental group G; opt-in, costed, isolated from default policy

confounders: a quiet window is a cadence observation, not evidence of project intent or neglect

seasonality and release cadence differ by project
limits: per-window concrete findings only; no aggregated suspicion score
never names a cause and never calls a change malicious or harmful
